Title: Streptolaurenis — Petri Dish Coasters, Set of 4
Body (HTML):
A set of four coasters that look exactly like lab culture plates: bright red agar, streaked with dark colonies of a brand-new species, Streptolaurenis. Guaranteed to start a conversation, and possibly to clear a room.

Each one is poured in a real lab petri dish and comes with its lid. The “bacteria” are UV resin, drawn on in the zig-zag streak pattern a lab uses to spread out a sample, and then sealed under a clear top layer. So they're completely safe to use, and you can set a mug or a water bottle down on them.

The idea came from Janet's niece Lauren, a science student, who took hers into the lab and set her water bottle down on it. It gave her professor quite a fright. The name is in her honour.
